submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily as Sb went down: 0.0047% at Sb 0.48, 0.039% at 0.34, 0.216% at 0.20 and 0.365% at 0.162. Sb 0.68 gave 0.0067%. XRD at Sb 0.13, 0.20 and 0.28 all showed the same rutile-type (FeSbO4-like) pattern. At Sb 0.128 there was also a weak peak at low Q (0.80 1/Å) that the other two lacked, which may be a second phase. Index 2 is the highest EQE measured. Indices 0 and 1 were not measured and could be higher, since the trend is still rising.
